   - Older homes may have sections that are not up to current codes. Bringing everything up to code during a remodel can be a massive, expensive undertaking. In some cases, local authorities might have grandfather clauses that allow older homes to retain certain non-code-compliant elements.

   - Before deciding to proceed with remodeling work that isn’t up to code, it’s crucial to consult with professionals. They can provide advice on the implications, costs, and potential alternatives to ensure you make an informed decision.

5. **Inspect Wiring and Connections**:
   - Check all wire connections to the fixture to ensure they are secure.
